title: Water heater leaking?

scenes.say: Water on the floor around your water heater?
scenes.visual: a water heater in a basement with a puddle spreading on the concrete floor

scenes.say: Turn off the cold water valve on top of the tank.
scenes.visual: a hand turning a valve handle on a pipe above a water heater

scenes.say: Gas heater? Turn the control to off or pilot.
scenes.visual: close up of a gas control dial on the front of a water heater

scenes.say: Electric heater? Switch off its breaker.
scenes.visual: a finger flipping a breaker switch in an electrical panel

scenes.say: Read the brand and age off the label if you can.
scenes.visual: a flashlight shining on the rating label on the side of a water heater

scenes.say: It helps us bring the right parts.
scenes.visual: an open toolbox with pipe fittings and wrenches on a basement floor
a clean white plumbing service van parked on a quiet small-town street at dusk, warm lights in the houses

caption: Leaking water heater? Do these steps, then call. Repairs and full replacements for homes and businesses.
